Subject: Initial request — BrightBridge webinar attendee credits

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

Thanks again for working with us on the BrightBridge webinar next week. As discussed on the call, we need a one-time distribution of trial allowance for webinar attendees and a small VIP add-on for speakers. Initial ask below: 

- 500 attendee trial allowances (each provides a 14-day trial credit bundle)
- 5 VIP speaker top-ups (additional 1,000 token credit each)

Attached is the preliminary attendee export (brightbridge_attendees_list.csv). We discovered a couple of duplicate registrations and some govcloud-flagged accounts in column G — will those require a different distribution path?

Deadline: all codes need to be issued by EOD Friday so the event team can include them in the post-event email.

Attaching the attendee list for your allocation workflow.

Thanks,
Sam Ellis

ops@ellis.events

Sam — thanks for the file. Quick confirmations before we allocate:

1) We can do the 500 attendee trial allowances and the 5 VIP top-ups. The standard attendee bundle is the 14-day starter allowance (tier A).
2) Duplicates: we will dedupe by email; please flag which emails should remain if the same person registered twice.
3) GovCloud accounts: those need Private deployment keys and a manual handoff to our Private delivery queue. We'll need a separate CSV with the govcloud flag set; distribution for those will take longer (24–48 hrs).

Marissa — can you prepare an allocation CSV that maps code -> email and include a column for "allocation_type" (attendee | vip | govcloud) so we can reissue quickly? If you need an exception to the standard unit cap for VIPs, loop in Rishi.

I'll hold distribution until I have the final deduped list.

— Lauren
